text:
Maya: Quick capture from today's all-hands — collecting owners and explicit due dates for the reliability follow-ups. I'll drop what I heard and please correct/assign.
Alex: Thanks — this is great. Short clarification: which RCA link is canonical?
Maya: The RCA we published is here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INC/pages/1977/rls-incident-rca (working doc)
Dinesh: I'll own the "router backpressure" mitigation (hotfix + config guardrails). Owner: Dinesh. ETA: Tue EOD PST. @Tanvi if we need infra help.
Tanvi: Ack. I'll validate the canary and add an autoscale guard next week. ETA: Thu EOD. Also adding a perf test job.
Frank: I'll own the rollout policy update in Console (make rollback default on canary fail). ETA: Fri.
Maya: Action: add owners to the RCA page + set JIRA tickets.
Eli (ops-bot): New ticket created: RINF-859 (router backpressure mitigation) — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RINF-859 :eyes:
Alex: Question on fallback model routing — do we need to update smart-routing policy? @Dinesh
Dinesh: Yes. Plan: route to smaller quantized variant automatically when tail latency > 250ms for 5m. I'll PR policy by Wed.
Tanvi: For Dedicated customers, we need a communication plan. I'll draft a short note for CSMs. ETA Wed noon.
Maya: Also: can someone add the perf trace and a short triage summary to the RCA? Helps exec sync.
Frank: I'll paste the trace here in the RCA page.
Dinesh: Quick command we used during mitigation:
``
./run-canary -m router -k 8 --concurrency 400 --profile=latency
```
Maya: Great. Last: owners, please update the RCA with 'owner:' and 'due:' fields and drop links here when created. I'll follow up in next all-hands.
Tanvi: Updated RCA with owner/due for my items: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INC/pages/1977#attachments
Alex: Any blockers?
Dinesh: None from infra. Waiting on perf results from Tanvi.
Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
